rows.value: Turnover up to TZS 4,000,000: nil. Over 4,000,000 to 7,000,000: TZS 100,000 (records incomplete) or 3% of the excess over 4,000,000 (records kept). Over 7,000,000 to 11,000,000: TZS 250,000 or TZS 90,000 plus 3% of the excess over 7,000,000. New individual businesses: nil for the first twelve months
